anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Before the sustained transition, distillate flow was 0.331 and reflux flow 0.338.
Distillate flow collapsed to 0.004 while reflux rose to 1.488.
System pressure fell from 649.409 to 392.31 mbar, column differential pressure fell from 0.980 to 0.381 mbar, and buffer differential pressure rose from 1.989 to 6.896 mbar.
The changed regime persisted: distillate 0.006, reflux 1.286, system pressure 400.862 mbar, column differential 0.339 mbar, and buffer differential 6.481 mbar.
Both level switches remain at 1; cooling-water flow remains present at 4.554.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol phase and commanded pressure/reflux changes are needed to exclude an intended transition; valve, vacuum-system and buffer-path checks are needed to identify the cause. Temperature sensors are not installed. No composition measurement or target specification is available.
